note: The single declared marker for llama-server's launch-argument rejection of --reasoning-budget. Two consumers used to pattern-match this independently and drifted: the CI decision script matched the full b8185 string 'error while handling argument "--reasoning-budget": invalid value', while the bundled b8571 emits 'error while handling argument "--reasoning-budget": invalid stoi argument' — so the detector could not fire on the build actually shipped. Match the PREFIX (the argument name), never the suffix (the parser's per-build wording). Consumers: (1) the runtime launch path, LlamaServerOps.isReasoningBudgetRejection — the authoritative signal that a build cannot honour the flag; (2) scripts/ci/lib/llama-server-arg-rejection.mjs, which reads THIS file at runtime, so the JS side holds no copy. The Java constant is pinned to this file by LlamaServerArgRejectionContractTest — drift fails the build.
